verdict.rationale: Gumloop's docs say it supports connecting to any MCP server, so agents can use specialized tools, internal services or any MCP-compatible API. Enterprise features add proxied connections to existing external MCP servers and hosted custom MCP servers that agents can use. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP tools work in agents, and evidence of setup details such as supported transports and auth configuration for custom servers.
